title: nice and simple
body:
I've used a few habit tracking apps including Coach.me (Lift) and Productive. But Way of Life is my favorite so far due to its simplicity and clean interface. I like how you can quickly see the overview of your all habits and quickly mark them off as done, not done, or skip. 

The app keep track of your streaks to reinforce sticking to your habits. You can add notes to your habits for the day, and see stats for your performance (haven't used this feature much yet, but it does looks pretty good).

Overall, the app is fast, simple, and it does what it's supposed to do: help track your habits quickly and effectively.
